item.title: Opposition Claims President Lee Used Anti-Corruption Commission as 'Self-Absolution' for 'Helicopter Transport Privilege' (野 “李대통령, 권익위 쥐고 ‘헬기 특혜 이송’에 셀프 면죄부”)
item.description:
Opposition Claims President Lee Used Anti-Corruption Commission as 'Self-Absolution' for 'Helicopter Transport Privilege' (野 “李대통령, 권익위 쥐고 ‘헬기 특혜 이송’에 셀프 면죄부”)

On the 9th, the People Power Party criticized the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission's announcement that there were issues in the past handling of the so-called 'emergency helicopter transport privilege controversy' involving President Lee Jae-myung during his tenure as leader of the Democratic Party of Korea. They stated, "Ahead of local elections, a state agency has volunteered as a 'memory laundry' to wipe away the president's past blemishes." <<> Senior Spokesperson Park Sung-hoon issued a commentary that day, saying, "The outcome presented by the Anti-Corruption Commission under the grandiose name of a 'Normalization Task Force (TF)' is nothing more than a 'regime-tailored past laundry.'" <<> He added, "At that time, President Lee Jae-myung bypassed Pusan National University Hospital, which is equipped with the nation's top-level regional trauma center, and called an emergency helicopter like a 'call taxi' to head to Seoul," and asked, "Is giving absolution for an act that undermined trust in local medical services and shook the foundation of the medical delivery system what the Anti-Corruption Commission calls normalization?" <<> He further argued, "The act of forcibly dragging in issues related to First Lady Kim Keon-hee and indiscriminately requesting investigations is merely a 'childish distraction' and a 'political offensive for elections,' aimed at diluting criticism over the 'helicopter privilege' controversy." <<> Previously, the Anti-Corruption Commission announced the day before that, through the activities of the Normalization TF, it had deemed inappropriate the 2004 ruling that the medical staff violated the code of conduct regarding the 'emergency helicopter transport privilege controversy,' and that the then-Secretary General had improperly intervened in this process. <<> President Lee posted a link to an article about the Anti-Corruption Commission's announcement on X (formerly Twitter) and stated, "Judicial murder through the prosecution's fabricated indictment, murder with a weapon by mobilizing terrorists, and character assassination through manipulated media. The people, that is, heaven, saved me from these grave three threats of murder." <<> In response, People Power Party lawmaker Na Kyung-won wrote on Facebook, calling it a "jaw-dropping sophistry," and said, "Under the pretext of normalizing the Anti-Corruption Commission, he twisted and shook the commission to grant himself absolution for his 'helicopter transport privilege.' Now, he's even packaging legitimate legal judgment as 'judicial murder' and pathologically obsessing over dropping charges." <<> She continued, "President Lee should stop his self-styled crime laundering and self-deification and face the suspended trials first." <<> (국민의힘은 9일 이재명 대통령의 더불어민주당 대표 때 불거진 이른바 ‘응급 헬기 이송 특혜 논란’과 관련, 과거 처리 과정에 문제가 있었다고 권익위가 발표한 것에 대해 “지방선거를 앞두고 대통령의 과거 치부를 지워주기 위해 국가기관이 스스로 ‘기억 세탁소’를 자처한 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Ahn Gyu-baek to Visit U.S. Tomorrow... Discussions on Wartime Operational Control and U.S. Forces Korea (안규백, 내일 미국 간다... 전작권, 주한미군 등 논의)
item.description:
Ahn Gyu-baek to Visit U.S. Tomorrow... Discussions on Wartime Operational Control and U.S. Forces Korea (안규백, 내일 미국 간다... 전작권, 주한미군 등 논의)

Amid tensions between South Korea and the U.S. over issues such as the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) and intelligence sharing on North Korea, Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-baek is making a surprise visit to the United States. (한미가 전시작전통제권(전작권) 전환, 대북 정보 공유 등 여러 현안과 관련해 갈등을 빚는 가운데 안규백 국방부 장관이 전격적으로 미국을 찾는다.)

The Ministry of National Defense announced on the 9th that Minister Ahn will visit the U.S. from the 10th to the 14th. This marks Ahn's first trip to the U.S. since taking office in July of last year. (국방부는 안 장관이 오는 10∼14일 미국을 방문한다고 9일 밝혔다. 지난해 7월 취임한 안 장관의 첫 방미다.)

Minister Ahn is scheduled to hold talks with U.S. Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth in Washington D.C. on the 11th (local time), and will meet with U.S. government and congressional officials, including the Acting Secretary of the Navy, the Chair and Ranking Member of the Senate Armed Services Committee, and the Chair of the Seapower Subcommittee. (안 장관은 11일(현지시각) 워싱턴D.C에서 피트 헤그세스 미국 국방부(전쟁부) 장관과 회담을 하고, 미국 해군성장관 대행, 상원 군사위원장 및 간사, 해양력소위원장 등 미측 정부와 의회 인사를 만날 예정이다.)

A defense ministry official stated regarding the visit, "It is aimed at direct high-level communication to follow up on the implementation of agreements from the South Korea-U.S. summit and the Security Consultative Meeting (SCM)," adding, "Key issues such as OPCON transfer and nuclear-powered submarines will be discussed." (국방부 관계자는 이번 방미에 대해 “한미정상회담, SCM 합의사항 후속조치 관련 이행 점검차 고위급 간 직접 소통하려는 것”이라며 “전작권, 핵추진잠수함 등이 주요 현안으로 논의될 것”이라고 말했다.)

The visit comes at a time when sensitive issues between Seoul and Washington have accumulated, including OPCON transfer, cooperation in building nuclear-powered submarines, contributions to freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz, and U.S. restrictions on sharing satellite intelligence on North Korea. (이번 방미는 전작권은 물론 핵추진잠수함 건조 협력, 호르무즈 해협 항행자유 기여 문제, 미국의 대북위성정보 공유 제한 등 한미간 민감한 현안이 누적된 가운데 이뤄지는 것이다.)

The Lee Jae-myung administration, which has set OPCON transfer within its term as a national task, is considering 2028—before the current U.S. administration's term ends—as a target year for the transfer. (임기 내 전작권 전환을 국정과제로 추진하는 이재명 정부는 한미 현 행정부 임기가 끝나기 전인 2028년을 전작권 전환 목표연도로 검토하고 있다.)

At last year's SCM, the two defense ministers agreed to establish a roadmap for meeting OPCON transfer conditions and to complete the second of three verification phases this year. (양국 국방장관이 지난해 개최한 한미안보협의회(SCM)에서는 전작권 전환 조건 충족에 관한 로드맵을 마련하고 3단계 조건 달성 여부 검증 절차 중 2단계를 올해 중 완료하기로 합의하기도 했다.)

However, recent testimony by U.S. Forces Korea Commander General Xavier Brunson in a congressional hearing, where he mentioned the first quarter of 2029 as a target, revealed a gap in perceptions. (그러나 최근 제이비어 브런슨 주한미군사령관이 의회 청문회에서 2029년 1분기를 목표 시점으로 언급하며 인식차가 드러났다.)

Cooperation on building nuclear-powered submarines, as agreed in the joint fact sheet issued by the South Korean and U.S. presidents last year, has been slow to advance in follow-up consultations amid the negative fallout from the "Coupang issue." (한미 정상이 지난해 조인트 팩트시트(공동 설명자료)에서 합의한 핵추진잠수함 건조 협력 등은 쿠팡 문제의 부정적 여파 속에서 좀처럼 후속 협의에 속도를 내지 못하는 상황이다.)

The government faces growing concerns as the U.S. recently urged South Korea to contribute to efforts to resume navigation through the Strait of Hormuz. President Trump also inflated the size of U.S. Forces Korea to 45,000 troops while expressing dissatisfaction with South Korea. (최근 미국이 호르무즈 해협 통항 재개를 위한 노력에 한국의 기여를 촉구하면서 정부로서는 고민이 늘어난 상황이 됐다. 트럼프 대통령은 한국에 불만을 표출하는 과정에서 주한미군 규모를 ‘4만5000명’이라고 부풀려 말하기도 했다.)

Attention is focused on whether this direct meeting between the top defense officials of South Korea and the U.S. can create a turning point in addressing the overall alliance agenda. (이런 가운데 진행되는 한미 국방 수장의 직접 대좌를 통해 동맹 현안 전반에 국면 전환의 단초를 만들 수 있을지 주목된다.)

During his U.S. visit, Minister Ahn is also expected to meet with the Acting Secretary of the Navy, where the issue of nuclear submarines is likely to be discussed. (안 장관은 방미 중 미국 해군성 장관 대행도 만날 예정으로, 해당 면담에서도 핵잠 문제가 논의될 것으로 보인다.)

Coinciding with Minister Ahn's visit, South Korea and the U.S. will hold the Korea-U.S. Integrated Defense Dialogue (KIDD), a deputy minister-level defense consultative body, in Washington D.C. on the 12th and 13th. (한미는 안 장관 방미 기간과 맞물리는 12∼13일 미국 워싱턴DC에서 국방당국 차관보급 회의체인 ‘통합국방협의체’(KIDD) 회의도 개최한다.)

The KIDD meeting will also address overall alliance security issues, including OPCON transfer. Some speculate that Minister Ahn's separate visit to the U.S. may reflect an awareness of the need to create a inflection point through high-level consultations. (KIDD 회의에서도 전작권 등 동맹 안보현안 전반이 논의되는데 안 장관이 별도로 방미하는 것은 고위급 협의를 통한 변곡점 마련 필요성을 의식한 것 아니냐는 관측도 제기된다.)

Amid a series of recent flashpoints in South Korea-U.S. relations, visits by key South Korean officials to the U.S. have been ongoing. Late last month, Jeong Yeon-doo, Director of the Foreign Ministry's Foreign Policy and Intelligence Division, and Cho Hyun-woo, Senior Presidential Secretary for Security Strategy, visited Washington D.C. (최근 한미 현안이 잇달아 불거진 가운데 한국 핵심 당국자들의 방미가 이어지는 양상이다. 지난달 하순에는 한국 정부의 대북 외교 수석대표인 정연두 외교부 외교전략정보본부장과 조현우 청와대 안보전략비서관이 워싱턴D.C를 찾았다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "Kim Eo-jun Confirms His Role as Ruling Party's Kingmaker… If Jung Won-oh Becomes Mayor, TBS Will Become the 'Teol Bo System'" (장동혁 “김어준, 與 상왕 인증…정원오 시장되면 TBS가 ‘털보시스템’으로”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk: "Kim Eo-jun Confirms His Role as Ruling Party's Kingmaker… If Jung Won-oh Becomes Mayor, TBS Will Become the 'Teol Bo System'" (장동혁 “김어준, 與 상왕 인증…정원오 시장되면 TBS가 ‘털보시스템’으로”)

Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, stated on the 9th regarding the extensive appearances of Democratic Party of Korea candidates for metropolitan mayoral and gubernatorial positions on broadcaster Kim Eo-jun's show, "Kim Eo-jun has confirmed that he is the true kingmaker of the Democratic Party." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 9일 방송인 김어준씨 방송에 더불어민주당 광역단체장 후보들이 대거 출연한 것을 두고 “김어준이 진짜 민주당 상왕임을 인증했다”고 했다.)

Representative Jang posted on Facebook that day, saying, "Among the 16 metropolitan candidates, including Jung Won-oh, Choo Mi-ae, Jeon Jae-soo, Kim Sang-wook, Kim Kyung-soo, and Woo Sang-ho, 14 of them bowed their heads before Kim Eo-jun," and made this statement. (장 대표는 이날 페이스북을 통해 “정원오, 추미애, 전재수, 김상욱, 김경수, 우상호 등 16명 광역단체장 후보들 중에 14명이 김어준 앞에 머리를 조아렸다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

Jang asserted, "Lee Jae-myung has all but ruined his chances of avoiding prison, and Jeong Cheong-rae, while trying to play the 'oppa' role, is losing votes, so they have no choice but to prostrate themselves before Kim Eo-jun, who even raises funds for them." (장 대표는 “이재명은 감방 안 가려다 산통 다 깨고, 정청래는 ‘오빠’ 되려다가 표 날리는 판이니 후원금까지 모아주는 김어준에게 납작 엎드릴 수밖에 없다”고 주장했다.)

He further remarked, "Kim Eo-jun, whom even Lee Jae-myung can't touch, now holds the reins of the Democratic Party candidates. If they become mayors or governors, public officials might have to wait outside Kim's door with approval documents in hand." (이어 “이재명도 못 건드리는 김어준이 민주당 후보들 목줄까지 쥐었으니 이들이 시장되고 도지사되면 공무원들이 결재판 들고 김어준 방 앞에 대기해야 할지도 모르겠다”고 말했다.)

Specifically targeting Jung Won-oh, the Democratic Party candidate for Seoul mayor, Jang argued, "If Jung Won-oh somehow becomes mayor, TBS [a local broadcaster] will be rebranded as the 'Teol Bo System' [a play on 'bearded man system,' referencing Kim's nickname 'Teol Bo']. This is a reference to Kim's nickname 'Teol Bo' (hairy man)." (장 대표는 특히 정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보를 겨냥해 “혹시라도 정원오가 시장되면 TBS는 ‘Teol Bo System’(털보 시스템)으로 바뀌겠다”고 주장했다. 김씨의 별칭인 ‘털보’를 언급한 표현이다.)

He added, "Lee Jae-myung is ruining the country, Kim Eo-jun is ruining Lee Jae-myung, and they're ruining the local governments too," concluding, "South Korea has truly become a country that makes you scratch your head." (그러면서 “이재명은 나라 말아먹고, 김어준은 이재명 말아먹고, 지방까지 말아먹고 있다”며 “대한민국이 진짜로 골 때리는 나라가 됐다”고 했다.)

item.title: "Jang Dong-hyuk, not satisfied with the 'Yoon Again' regression, tramples on the wounded hearts of the people" (與 “장동혁, 윤어게인 회귀도 모자라 상처입은 국민마음 짓밟아”)
item.description:
"Jang Dong-hyuk, not satisfied with the 'Yoon Again' regression, tramples on the wounded hearts of the people" (與 “장동혁, 윤어게인 회귀도 모자라 상처입은 국민마음 짓밟아” )

The Democratic Party of Korea criticized on the 9th, "The People Power Party is not only reverting to 'Yoon Again,' but has also trampled on the hearts of the people wounded by the insurrection." <<> Senior Spokesperson Kang Jun-hyun stated in a written briefing, referring to remarks by People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk during a foreign press conference where he said "Impeachment is not the only way to resolve the martial law," calling it "rash nonsense." <<> Senior Spokesperson Kang said, "Does Representative Jang truly not understand why the people cried out with earnest hearts for Yoon Seok-youl's impeachment?" and added, "Instead of healing the hearts of the people wounded by the insurrection, Representative Jang's actions, which deepen those wounds, leave us unable to contain our anger and shock." <<> Regarding Representative Jang's comments that "there is God's plan even in the martial law," Kang said, "What exists in the emergency martial law is not God's plan but the resolute judgment of the people," and "There will never be salvation for the People Power Party, which has betrayed the sovereign people." <<> He continued, "It is deplorable to see the spirit of Jesus, symbolizing love and sacrifice, being misused to justify acts of insurrection," adding, "Representative Jang should reflect on whether he is qualified to appeal for the people's choice." (더불어민주당은 9일 “국민의힘이 ‘윤어게인’으로 회귀하는 것도 모자라 내란으로 상처 입은 국민의 마음마저 짓밟았다”고 비판했다.)

item.title: Chung Won-oh: “Yongsan Development Cannot Follow Oh Se-hoon’s Approach” Oh: “The Cause Is the Moon Jae-in and Lee Jae-myung Governments” (정원오 “용산 개발 오세훈식으로 안 돼” 吳 “원인은 문재인·이재명 정부”)
item.description:
Chung Won-oh: “Yongsan Development Cannot Follow Oh Se-hoon’s Approach” Oh: “The Cause Is the Moon Jae-in and Lee Jae-myung Governments” (정원오 “용산 개발 오세훈식으로 안 돼” 吳 “원인은 문재인·이재명 정부”)

On the 9th, Democratic Party of Korea Seoul mayoral candidate Chung Won-oh, regarding the development issues of Yongsan—a key area in the so-called Han River Belt—stated, “Candidate Oh Se-hoon, during your four terms as Seoul mayor, why did you leave this land so neglected?” (더불어민주당 정원오 서울시장 후보는 9일 이른바 한강벨트의 핵심 지역인 용산의 개발 문제와 관련, “오세훈 후보는 서울시장 4번 할 동안 이 땅을 왜 이렇게 내버려 뒀는가”라고 했다.)

In a Facebook post that day, Candidate Chung said, “Among all metropolitan cities and provinces nationwide, Seoul’s growth rate ranking has fallen to 8th, 10th, and 11th over the three years from 2022. The reason is Yongsan,” making this assertion. (정 후보는 이날 페이스북에 올린 글에서 “전국의 광역시도 중 서울의 성장률 순위는 2022년부터 3년 동안 8위, 10위, 11위로 떨어졌다. 이유는 용산”이라면서 이같이 밝혔다.)

He added, “The reason for Candidate Oh’s failure is clear. The biggest cause of Yongsan development being stranded in 2013 is that there was no clear entity responsible for seeing the development through to the end.” (그는 “오 후보가 실패한 원인은 분명하다”며 “2013년 용산 개발이 좌초된 가장 큰 이유는 마지막까지 개발을 책임질 주체가 분명하지 않았다는 점”이라고 했다.)

He further said, “We cannot proceed with the Oh Se-hoon approach. Chung Won-oh will develop it differently. If we go in the wrong direction, it will be stranded again, just like in the past.” (이어 “오세훈식으로 가면 안 된다. 정원오는 다르게 개발하겠다”며 “잘못된 방향으로 가면 과거처럼 또다시 좌초한다”고 했다.)

He continued, “Yongsan will stand tall as a global hub for AI policy and industry, spreading economic vitality across South Korea as Asia’s only economic base. I’ve done it myself in Seongsu.” (그러면서 “용산은 전 세계 AI 정책과 산업의 중심지로 우뚝 서고, 아시아 유일의 경제거점으로서 대한민국 전역에 경제활력을 전파할 것”이라며 “제가 성수에서 직접 해봤다”고 했다.)

Earlier, Candidate Chung had announced pledges the previous day, such as attracting a UN AI (Artificial Intelligence) hub to the Yongsan International Business District. (앞서 정 후보는 전날 용산국제업무지구에 유엔 AI(인공지능) 허브 유치 등의 공약을 발표한 바 있다.)

His emphasis on Candidate Oh’s responsibility for delays in Yongsan development appears to be a counterattack against Mayor Oh’s intensified offensive, linking real estate issues—deemed a weakness of the Democratic Party government—as a connecting thread. (그가 이날 오 후보의 용산 개발 지연 책임론을 부각한 것은 민주당 정부의 약점으로 꼽히는 부동산 문제를 연결고리로 오 시장이 공세를 강화한 것에 대한 반격 차원으로 보인다.)

On the 9th, People Power Party Seoul mayoral candidate Oh Se-hoon countered by invoking the original sin theory of the Democratic Party government. Oh said that day, “It’s preposterous and shameless. You don’t mention that during the 10 years of Moon Jae-in and Park Won-soon’s tenure, Yongsan development was at a standstill. Instead, you claim it’s been stalled by combining my 5 years before that and the current 5 years—it’s absurd.” (국민의힘 오세훈 서울시장 후보는 9일 민주당 정부 원죄론을 꺼내들며 반박했다. 오 후는 이날 “적반하장에 기가 막힌다”면서 “문재인·박원순 집권 10년 동안 (용산 개발이) 멈춰 서 있던 것은 전혀 언급하지 않고 제가 그전에 했던 5년과 지금 5년을 합해서 멈춰 서 있다고 말씀하시는 걸 보니 어이가 없다”고 말했다.)

He added, “The Yongsan International Business District development project was progressing smoothly, but it was the Lee Jae-myung government that suddenly unilaterally announced expanding the housing size, which had been agreed upon at 6,000 units, to 10,000 units, causing the plan to be delayed by about two years. And Candidate Chung is the one who endorsed that and proposed a pledge to include 10,000 units.” (그러면서 “용산국제업무지구 개발 사업은 순항하고 있었는데, 난데없이 6000 가구로 합의돼 있던 주택 규모를 일방적으로 1만 가구로 늘려 발표하면서 계획이 2년 정도 순연되도록 만든 게 바로 이재명 정부”라며 “그리고 그것을 그대로 용인해 1만 가구를 집어넣겠다는 공약을 내세운 게 정 후보”라고 했다.)

He said, “It’s like a driver from the next lane suddenly cutting into a smoothly running lane, throwing all lanes into chaos, and then, when an accident occurs, shamelessly blaming the driver who was driving properly. That’s exactly the role Candidate Chung is taking on now.” (그는 “순항 중인 차선에 옆 차선에서 갑자기 ‘칼치기’를 하고 들어와서 전체적인 차선을 전부 혼란스럽게 만들어 놓고, 나중에 사고가 나면 적반하장으로 잘 운행하고 있던 운전자 탓을 하는 비양심적인 운전자 역할을 지금 정 후보가 자임하고 있다”고 했다.)

Mayor Oh also remarked, “I hear quite a lot from broadcasts that the approval rating gap is gradually narrowing. I think, as time passes, the focus will inevitably shift to candidate competitiveness.” (오 시장은 또 “지지율 격차가 조금씩 줄어든다는 이야기는 방송에서도 꽤 많이 듣고 있다”면서 “아마 시간이 지날수록 인물 경쟁력에 초점이 맞춰질 수밖에 없을 것”이라고 말했다.)

Targeting Candidate Chung, he added, “To put it in a metaphor, it feels like a stage where, after tearing open the nitrogen packaging, the over-packaged state might be somewhat alleviating. I expect that as time goes on, the gap will narrow.” (그러면서 정 후보를 겨냥, “굳이 비유를 하자면 질소 포장지를 뜯어낸 상태에서 아마 과대 포장 상태가 조금 해소되는 그런 단계가 아닌가 그런 느낌을 받는다”면서 “아마 시간이 지날수록 격차는 좁혀지지 않을까 그렇게 기대하고 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Feeling the Crisis? Chung Cheong-rae Heads to Busan Again after 5 Days, "Full Support for Jeon Jae-soo, Who Resembles President Lee" (위기감 느꼈나...정청래, 닷새만에 또 부산행 “李 대통령 닮은 전재수 전폭 지원”)
item.description:
Feeling the Crisis? Chung Cheong-rae Heads to Busan Again after 5 Days, "Full Support for Jeon Jae-soo, Who Resembles President Lee" (위기감 느꼈나...정청래, 닷새만에 또 부산행 “李 대통령 닮은 전재수 전폭 지원” )

Democratic Party leader Chung Cheong-rae visited Busan on the 9th, one of the biggest battlegrounds in the June 3 local elections. Amid predictions that the proposal of a special counsel bill on fabricated indictments—which could enable the dismissal of President Lee Jae-myung's case—may consolidate conservative support in Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang (PK) following Daegu and North Gyeongsang (TK), he returned to Busan just five days after his last visit on the 4th. (더불어민주당 정청래 대표는 9일 6·3 지방선거 최대 격전지 중 하나인 부산을 찾았다. 이재명 대통령의 사건을 공소 취소할 수 있게 한 조작 기소 특검법안 발의로 대구·경북(TK)에 이어 부산·울산·경남(PK)에서도 보수층 결집이 될 수 있다는 전망이 나온 가운데 지난 4일에 이어 닷새 만에 다시 부산행에 나선 것이다.)

Leader Chung attended the opening ceremony of Jeon Jae-soo's Busan mayoral candidate campaign office on that afternoon. (정 대표는 이날 오후 전재수 부산시장 후보 선거사무소 개소식에 참석했다.)

Chung stated, "It was because of Jeon Jae-soo and President Lee Jae-myung that the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries relocated to Busan," adding, "This was possible because Jeon Jae-soo resembles President Lee." (정 대표는 “전재수가 있었기에, 이재명 대통령이 있었기에 해양수산부가 부산으로 이전했다”며 “이 대통령 닮은 전재수였기 때문에 가능했다”고 말했다.)

He continued, "Jeon Jae-soo often throws out numbers. When President Lee speaks at cabinet meetings, he is precise, and Jeon is just like him. His meticulousness also mirrors President Lee." (이어 “전재수는 걸핏하면 숫자를 얘기한다. 이 대통령이 국무회의할 때 보면 정확하게 얘기하는데 이 대통령을 닮았다”며 “꼼꼼한 것도 이 대통령을 닮았다”고 했다.)

Chung said, "I will help Jeon Jae-soo with whatever he wants to do," and pledged, "The party will spare no effort and provide all possible support." (정 대표는 “전재수가 하고 싶은 일이라면 무엇이든 다 도와드리겠다”며 “당에서 할 수 있는 모든 것을 아끼지 않고 다 지원하겠다”고 했다.)

He added, "Busan is never alone because it has the ruling Democratic Party and the Lee Jae-myung government behind it," and expressed confidence, "I believe Busan will become a maritime capital where people return, not a city they leave." (그러면서 “부산은 뒤에 민주당이라는 여당이 있고 이재명 정부가 있기 때문에 결코 외롭지 않다”며 “떠나는 도시가 아니라 사람들이 다시 부산을 찾는 해양 수도가 될 것으로 믿는다”고 했다.)

In response, candidate Jeon remarked, "For the past 30 years, Busan's city administration has achieved nothing," and noted, "Mayor Park Hyung-joon worked hard in his own way, but there were no results. I can no longer stand by a city government without achievements." He added, "It makes no sense to say you worked hard while not doing what citizens want. I will become a mayor who thoroughly pursues what citizens want." Along with his wife, Jeon bowed deeply to party members and citizens who attended the opening ceremony. (이에 전 후보는 “지난 30년 동안 성과 없는 부산 시정이 지속됐다”며 “박형준 시장도 나름 열심히 일했지만, 성과는 없었다. 더 이상 성과없는 시정을 두고 볼 수 없다”고 말했다. 이어 “시민들이 원하는 일을 하지 않고 열심히 일했다는 것은 말이 되지 않는다”며 “철저하게 시민이 원하는 시장이 되겠다”고 했다. 전 후보는 부인과 함께 개소식을 찾은 당원과 시민들에게 큰절을 올렸다.)

Floor leader Han Byung-do attended the opening ceremony of Song Young-gil's campaign office for the Incheon Yeonsu Gap by-election and supported candidate Song. (한병도 원내대표는 이날 인천 연수갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 송영길 후보 선거사무소 개소식에 참석해 송 후보를 지원했다.)

Floor leader Han stated, "Song Young-gil's path has been the path of the Democratic Party, and his responsibility and dedication have always been embedded in it," and added, "Han Byung-do and the Democratic Party will stand with candidate Song for the leap forward of Yeonsu-gu." (한 원내대표는 “송영길의 길이 민주당의 길이었고, 그 속에 언제나 송영길의 책임과 헌신이 녹아있었다”며 “송 후보와 연수구의 도약을 위해 민주당과 한병도가 함께하겠다”고 말했다.)

Candidate Song said, "Once in the National Assembly, I will help President Lee Jae-myung, who is fighting alone, to restore Korea-Russia relations," and pledged, "I will transform Incheon anew." (송 후보는 “국회에 들어가면 고군분투하는 이재명 대통령을 도와 한러 관계를 복원시키겠다”며 “인천을 새롭게 만들겠다”고 했다.)

The opening ceremony was attended by lawmaker Park Chan-dae, a three-term representative for Yeonsu Gap; candidate Kim Nam-joon, running for the Gyeyang-eul by-election, Song's former district; and Kim Yong, former vice director of the Democratic Research Institute, among others. (개소식에는 연수갑에서 3선을 지낸 박찬대 의원, 송 후보의 옛 지역구였던 계양을 보궐선거에 출마한 김남준 후보, 김용 전 민주연구원 부원장 등이 참석했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "When I Asked My Elderly Mother What 'Indictment Withdrawal' Means, She Got Angry, Saying 'Are You Disrespecting Me?'" (장동혁 “노모에 ‘공소 취소’ 뜻 물어보니 ‘나 무시하냐’며 역정”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk: "When I Asked My Elderly Mother What 'Indictment Withdrawal' Means, She Got Angry, Saying 'Are You Disrespecting Me?'" (장동혁 “노모에 ‘공소 취소’ 뜻 물어보니 ‘나 무시하냐’며 역정”)

On the 9th, People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, regarding the so-called 'Special Bill on Manipulated Indictments,' shared an anecdote about asking his elderly mother what 'indictment withdrawal' meant and getting scolded, indirectly criticizing Democratic Party lawmaker Park Seong-jun, who said that 'a significant number of citizens don't know what indictment withdrawal means.' (국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 9일 이른바 ‘조작기소 특검법안’과 관련, 자신의 노모에게 공소취소의 뜻이 무엇인지 물었다가 혼났다는 일화를 전하면서 ‘국민 상당수는 공소취소를 모른다’는 취지로 발언한 더불어민주당 박성준 의원을 우회적으로 비판했다.)

Jang, a former judge, wrote on Facebook that day, "I saw my 95-year-old mother for the first time in a while. She was muttering that Lee Jae-myung lied about selling his house and now he's making a fuss about withdrawing the indictment, so I asked her if she knew what indictment withdrawal means." (판사 출신인 장 대표는 이날 페이스북에 “오랜만에 95세 노모를 뵈었다. (어머니께서) 이재명이 집 팔았다고 거짓말하더니 이제 공소 취소한다고 지랄이라고 구시렁거리시길래 공소 취소가 무언지 아시냐 물었다”고 썼다.)

He continued, saying his mother got upset and said, "Are you disrespecting me?" Adding, "Oh well, it wasn't disrespect—I was just asking because the Democratic Party's Park Seong-jun said nine out of ten people don't even know what indictment withdrawal means..." (이어 자신의 어머니가 “너 나 무시허냐”며 역정을 냈다면서 “참나, 무시하는 것이 아니라 민주당 박성준이 국민 열에 아홉은 공소취소가 뭔지도 모른다고 해서 물어본 건데…”라고 했다.)

Earlier, on the 6th, Park appeared on a radio program and mentioned, "Ask citizens 'What is indictment withdrawal?' Eight to nine out of ten people don't know the meaning well." (앞서 박 의원은 지난 6일 라디오 방송에 출연해 “시민들에게 ‘공소취소가 뭐예요?’라고 물어보라. 10명 중 8~9명은 뜻을 잘 모른다”고 언급한 바 있다.)

Meanwhile, regarding the Korean cargo ship HMM Namu, which recently caught fire while anchored in the Strait of Hormuz—blocked due to the US-Iran war—Jang wrote, "The government seems to be preparing to conclude it's not an attack, even though it should be thoroughly preparing for an attack scenario. What are they so afraid of?" (한편 장 대표는 미국과 이란의 전쟁으로 봉쇄된 호르무즈 해협에서 정박하다 최근 화재가 발생한 한국 화물선 HMM 나무호와 관련, “(정부가) ‘피격’을 염두에 두고 철저하게 대비해도 모자랄 판에, 아니라고 결론 내릴 준비부터 하는 것 같다”며 “뭐가 그리 무서운 걸까”라고 적었다.)

He then addressed the government's humanitarian aid to Iran, saying, "We gave $500,000 to Iran, which is at war with our ally the US. We don't even have dialogue with the US, but we sent a special envoy to Iran. Everyone knows Iran is North Korea's friend. Is there something they're hiding?" (이어 정부의 대이란 인도 지원을 거론하며 “동맹국 미국과 전쟁 중인 이란에 돈 50만 달러를 갖다 바쳤다. 미국과는 대화도 안 하면서 이란에는 특사까지 보냈다”며 “이란이 북한 친구인 건 세상이 다 아는 사실이다. 뭐 꼬투리 잡힌 일이라도 있는 걸까”라고 말했다.)

He also posted a screenshot of Lee Jae-myung's SNS post from 2014 when he was mayor of Seongnam, which read, "Research paper says Cheonan collided with a submarine," and claimed, "At this rate, they might say the Namu also collided with a submarine." (그러면서 이재명 대통령이 2014년 성남시장 시절 SNS에 ‘’천안함은 잠수함과 충돌' 연구논문 나와’라고 쓴 글을 캡처해 올린 뒤 “이러다가 나무호도 잠수함과 충돌했다고 할지 모르겠다”라고 주장했다.)

item.title: Chung Cheong-rae: "Sejong City, Where Roh Moo-hyun Planted the Flag and Lee Hae-chan Cultivated... We Will Complete the Special Act on the Administrative Capital" (정청래 “노무현 깃발 꽂고 이해찬이 가꾼 세종시...행정수도특별법 완성할 것”)
item.description:
Chung Cheong-rae: "Sejong City, Where Roh Moo-hyun Planted the Flag and Lee Hae-chan Cultivated... We Will Complete the Special Act on the Administrative Capital" (정청래 “노무현 깃발 꽂고 이해찬이 가꾼 세종시...행정수도특별법 완성할 것”)

On the 9th, Chung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated, "Once the June 3 local elections are over, we will make every effort within the party to pass the Special Act on the Administrative Capital, ensuring that Sejong City—where former President Roh Moo-hyun planted the flag and former Prime Minister Lee Hae-chan nurtured with his hands—can function as a true administrative capital, with various benefits concentrated here." (정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 9일 “6·3 지방선거가 끝나면 본격적으로 행정수도특별법을 통과시켜 명실공히 노무현 (전) 대통령이 깃발을 꽂고 이해찬(전 총리)의 손으로 가꿔온 세종시가 행정수도로서 기능할 수 있도록, 각종 특혜가 이곳에 이뤄질 수 있도록 당에서 전심전력으로 행정수도특별법을 통과시키는 데 최선을 다하겠다”고 했다.)

Leader Chung attended the inaugural ceremony of Cho Sang-ho’s election campaign committee for Sejong Special City mayor that morning and said, "Former President Roh Moo-hyun promised to pass the Special Act on the Administrative Capital, but his plan to relocate the administrative capital was thwarted by the absurd reason of 'customary constitution.'" (정 대표는 이날 오전 조상호 세종특별시장 후보 선거대책위원회 발족식에 참석해 “‘행정수도특별법 반드시 통과시키겠다’ 노무현 (전) 대통령께서 공약하셨던 행정수도 이전이 관습 헌법이라는 말도 되지 않는 이유로 무산됐다”며 이같이 말했다.)

He continued, "While the name, location, and site of a complete capital will be determined through constitutional amendment, once the Special Act on the Administrative Capital is passed, Sejong City can fully establish its status as a specialized capital, and various corresponding benefits will follow. I also believe that matters such as the presidential office will progress step by step after the law is enacted." (이어 “완벽한 수도에 대한 명칭과 장소, 위치는 헌법 개정을 통해 이뤄지겠지만 행정수도특별법이 통과되면 특화 수도로서 세종시가 그 위상을 충분하게 가질 수 있고, 거기에 따른 여러 가지 특혜는 따라오리라 생각한다”며 “그리고 대통령 집무실 같은 경우도 앞으로 그 법이 통과되면 차차 진행될 것으로 믿고 있다”고 했다.)

He added, "If candidate Cho Sang-ho becomes Sejong City mayor, I will do my utmost so that people can physically and visually feel that 'the Lee Jae-myung administration and the Democratic Party are clearly supporting him.' In that case, Sejong City will become truly special—small in population but serving as a central hub that gathers and elevates Korea's energy." (그는 “조상호 후보가 세종시장이 되면 ‘확실하게 이재명 정부와 민주당이 확실하게 지원하고 있구나’ 하는 것을 몸으로, 눈으로 느낄 수 있도록 최선을 다하겠다”며 “이렇게 되면 세종시가 대한민국의 중심 도시로서 인구는 작지만 대한민국의 기운을 더 모아 상승시키는 진짜 특별한 도시가 될 것”이라고 말했다.)

Regarding candidate Cho, he remarked, "He knows the path that Lee Hae-chan walked better than anyone, and he has internalized the tasks Lee Hae-chan pursued and the spirit he embodied more than anyone. He is Lee Hae-chan’s shadow and his political son." (조 후보를 향해선 “이해찬이 걸어온 길을 누구보다 잘 알고 있고 또 이해찬이 하고자 했던 일, 또 이해찬이 갖고 있던 정신을 누구보다 몸으로 체화한 사람”이라며 “이해찬의 그림자고 이해찬의 정치적 아들”이라고 언급했다.)

Kang Jun-hyun, senior spokesperson for the Democratic Party, also said, "As soon as the local elections are over, we will fulfill our role in the National Assembly’s Land, Infrastructure, and Transport Committee to ensure this bill (the Special Act on the Administrative Capital) is passed. Together with candidate Cho, we will deliver a truly great gift to Sejong City." (강준현 민주당 수석대변인도 “지방선거 끝나자마자 (국회) 국토교통위원회에서 이(행정수도특별법) 법안을 반드시 통과시킬 수 있도록 국회에서 역할을 다하겠다”며 “조 후보와 합심해서 정말 큰 선물을 세종시에 안겨드리도록 하겠다”고 했다.)

Candidate Cho responded, "Since the leader has promised to take responsibility for the administrative capital, I will take responsibility for Sejong City’s self-sufficiency and quality of life. I believe that a nation where Seoul and the regions prosper evenly relies on the completion of the administrative capital." <<>> (조 후보는 “대표께서 행정수도는 책임져주신다고 하셨으니까 세종시 자족 기능과 삶의 질 문제는 제가 책임지겠다”며 “서울과 지방이 고르게 잘사는 나라가 되는 것은 행정수도의 완성에 달려 있다고 생각한다”고 말했다．)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon, Running in Busan North Gap, Says: "If President Lee Cancels Indictment, He Should Be Impeached" (부산 북갑 출마 한동훈 “李대통령, 공소 취소하면 탄핵돼야”)
item.description:
Han Dong-hoon, Running in Busan North Gap, Says: "If President Lee Cancels Indictment, He Should Be Impeached" (부산 북갑 출마 한동훈 “李대통령, 공소 취소하면 탄핵돼야”)

Han Dong-hoon, an independent candidate in the by-election for Busan North Gap's National Assembly seat, stated on the 9th, "If President Lee Jae-myung himself actually cancels the indictment, he should be impeached." (부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 한동훈 무소속 후보가 9일 “이재명 대통령 본인이 실제로 공소 취소를 하면 탄핵돼야 한다”고 밝혔다.)

Candidate Han held a press conference at a small park near Gupo Market in Buk-gu on this day and said, "I will work with the residents of Buk-gu to curb the reckless actions of the Lee Jae-myung regime and the regression of the Jang Dong-hyuk pro-party faction," making the remark. (한 후보는 이날 북구 구포시장 근처 쌈지공원에서 출마 기자회견을 열고 “이재명 정권이 막 나가는 것과 장동혁 당권파가 퇴행하는 것을 제어하는 일을 북구 주민과 함께하겠다”며 이같이 말했다.)

He added, "If I defeat the proxy sent by President Lee Jae-myung and serve as a check amid widespread attention, many situations will change. I will block the destruction of the constitution by defeating the proxy sent by President Lee, rebuild conservatism, and become an alternative force." (그는 “제가 대대적인 관심 속에 이재명 대통령이 보낸 대리인을 꺾고 견제 역할을 해낸다면 많은 상황이 바뀔 것”이라며 “이 대통령이 보낸 대리인을 꺾어 헌법 파괴를 막아내고, 보수를 재건해 대안 세력이 될 것”이라고 했다.)

Candidate Han said, "I believe I have been fighting the most regarding the 'special counsel for indictment cancellation.' If President Lee actually pushes forward with it, I will immediately take to the streets, persuade citizens, and impeach President Lee." (한 후보는 “‘공소 취소 특검’과 관련해 제가 제일 많이 싸우고 있다고 생각한다”며 “이 대통령이 진짜로 추진하면 바로 거리로 나가 시민들을 설득하고 이 대통령을 탄핵할 것”이라고 말했다.)

Regarding the leadership of the People Power Party, he said, "Some pro-party factions in the People Power Party are now struggling to beat me rather than the Democratic Party. Because of this regression, proper checks are not happening, which is why President Lee is acting so recklessly." (국민의힘 지도부에 대해서는 “지금 국민의힘 일부 당권파가 민주당이 아니라 저를 이기려고 애를 쓰고 있다”며 “이런 퇴행들 때문에 제대로 견제가 안 되고, 그러니까 이 대통령이 저렇게막 나가고 있는 것”이라고 했다.)

When asked about the possibility of returning to the People Power Party, Candidate Han replied, "I have never left the party. I was only unfairly expelled. Please remember what I said on the first day of my unfair expulsion: I will come back without fail." Regarding a potential single candidacy, he stated, "Such political issues are subordinate to the great aspirations of the public sentiment." (한 후보는 국민의힘 복귀 가능성에 대해 “저는 탈당한 적이 없다. 부당하게 제명당했을 뿐”이라며 “제가 부당하게 제명당한 첫날 했던 말씀을 기억해 달라. 저는 반드시 돌아간다”고 답했다. 단일화 여부에 대해서는 “큰 민심의 열망에서 그런 정치적 문제는 종속적인 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Jong-un Sends Congratulatory Message to Putin on Russia's Victory Day... "Will Always Fulfill Treaty Obligations Responsibly" (김정은, 러 전승절 맞아 푸틴에 축전…“조약이행 언제나 책임적”)
item.description:
Kim Jong-un Sends Congratulatory Message to Putin on Russia's Victory Day... "Will Always Fulfill Treaty Obligations Responsibly" (김정은, 러 전승절 맞아 푸틴에 축전…“조약이행 언제나 책임적” )

North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un sent a congratulatory message to President Vladimir Putin on the 81st anniversary of Russia's Victory Day in World War II, emphasizing the alliance between the two countries, stating that he "will always be responsible in fulfilling obligations under the DPRK-Russia inter-state treaty." <<> According to the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA), in his congratulatory message on the 9th, Kim reaffirmed "the position of the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (North Korea's official name) to place the utmost importance on the comprehensive strategic partnership and to unwaveringly elevate and develop it." <<> In the message, Kim conveyed congratulations on the 81st anniversary of Victory Day and emphasized that he "always feels satisfaction and pride" regarding North Korea-Russia relations. <<> Kim particularly highlighted personal closeness by referring to President Putin as his "closest comrade," "respected comrade Putin," or simply "Dear Vladimir Vladimirovich" without using his official title. <<> Kim stated, "Pyongyang is always with you and the fraternal Russian people," adding, "I wish only victory and glory on the path ahead for the Russian people. The great history of Russia's victories will continue." (김정은 북한 국무위원장이 러시아의 2차 세계대전 승리기념일(전승절) 81주년을 맞아 블라디미르 푸틴 대통령에게 축전을 보내 “조로(북러) 국가간 조약의 의무 이행에 언제나 책임적일 것”이라며 양국의 동맹관계를 강조했다.)
